description:
Container archival follows tracker document references. Artifacts whose owner is established by an identifier or commit provenance but which carry no document reference are linked at their current path.

## Background

Ownership is admissible only from an existing tracker document reference, an unambiguous issue identifier in the path or content, or unique `jit:<short-id>` commit provenance; an artifact without admissible evidence is unassociated and goes to `dev/archive/legacy/<original-relative-path>`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Every manifest file row whose owner is established by identifier or commit provenance has a tracker document reference on that owner at the artifact's current path. Directory rows carry no reference; the files beneath them have their own rows.
- [hard] REQ-02: Multi-owner rows are linked to every recorded owner; rows without admissible evidence receive no link.
- [hard] REQ-03: Tracker validation reports no new findings. New document-conformance findings are limited to multi-owner files and to files outside their owner's canonical directory, and the linked record gives the command that lists each.

## Decisions

- DEC-01: The owner decided on 2026-10-03 that directory rows are excluded from REQ-01, because tracker validation rejects a directory reference, and that REQ-03 admits conformance findings for multi-owner files and for files that the relocation tasks move.
title: Link unlinked owned artifacts to their issues
